tasks.title: Implement UniversalLanguage table-driven lexer and Sora dark theme decorators
constraints: Zero new third-party dependencies; pure DEX bytecode extending AsyncIncrementalAnalyzeManager.
Degradation evaluated first: any file exceeding NORMAL_MAX_BYTES (>1 MiB UTF-8 bytes) must return EmptyLanguage.
Retain JavaLanguage for normal-tier .java files; unknown extensions must return EmptyLanguage.
Lines exceeding 10,000 characters must scan state only without per-character spans; brackets inside comments/strings must not be matched.
Decorators must include SchemeDarcula, setPinLineNumber(true), isHighlightCurrentLine, isHighlightBracketPair, isBlockLineEnabled.
acceptance: Kotlin, Python, JS/TS, Rust, JSON, Shell, TOML, YAML, Markdown, and Dockerfile display distinct token colors under SchemeDarcula.
Bracket pairs match correctly excluding strings/comments, block line indent guides render, and line numbers remain visible during horizontal scrolling.
Degraded files (>1 MiB UTF-8) and unknown extensions fallback to EmptyLanguage without throwing exceptions.
Outgoing lexer state is preserved across lines exceeding 10,000 characters.
Language reassessment swaps to EmptyLanguage when UTF-8 bytes cross the 1 MiB threshold even if character count stays constant.

tasks.title: Implement Markdown and zero-WebView HTML rich previews in focused workspace
constraints: Strict zero-WebView invariant: zero imports of android.webkit.WebView or androidx.webkit.
No second text authority: preview consumes immutable document snapshot, never mutates tab.content, revision, or CAS metadata.
Single preview mode state: previewMode aliases markdownPreviewMode for full backward compatibility.
Accurate code-unit limits: snapshot and HTML reader parsing both capped at 262,144 characters (UTF-16 code units) with truncation notice.
acceptance: Preview/Source toggle button is visible in focused workspace for Markdown and HTML files.
Markdown renders parsed Compose blocks (headings, lists, code fences); HTML renders AnnotatedString.fromHtml.
Toggling preview preserves document dirty state, revision number, and undo stack.
Stale asynchronous parse results for superseded revisions are dropped.

tasks.title: Implement hardened AndroidVideoSurface, AndroidImageSurface, and AndroidMediaClient generation fencing
constraints: MediaLease.assertValidOwner must check connection-scoped owner supplier before and after network operations; cancel only owner-scoped calls synchronously and clear cache on retirement.
readRangeSync must validate HTTP 206, Content-Range presence, returnedStart == requestedStart, and returnedEnd <= requested interval; return -1 at EOF.
Image streaming read must cap at 32 MiB; image decoding must cap at 50 MP and use inSampleSize downsampling.

Video surface must eliminate surface/player creation race in both arrival orders, preserve aspect ratio, use 2 MiB LRU block cache, throttle range seeking, pause on tab disposal and ON_STOP, and synchronously release player with background non-blocking revocation.
acceptance: MediaClient throws MediaException on generation mismatch, retired connection, HTTP 200 on range offset, or mismatched Content-Range intervals.
Retirement cancels only the affected owner's calls without canceling unrelated profile traffic.
Images load and display with pan/pinch-zoom within fitted bounds without exceeding 50 MP decode limit.
Video plays with correct aspect ratio and inline controls without HTTP range request thrashing.
Player cleanup synchronously releases MediaPlayer even if ticket revocation fails or times out.

tasks.title: Integrate collapsible left file-tree sidebar, media playback, and zero-WebView HTML preview into editor workspace
constraints: Maintain stable CodeEditor view instance during responsive recomposition without swapping drawer components.
Back button interceptor must use clean register/unregister lambdas that restore prior navigation state.
Hardware keyboard and IME input must be suppressed in background editor when slide-over sidebar is open independently of previous editability, restoring natural read-only state on close.
Slide-over sidebar must request focus to ensure Escape key event delivery.
LocalDocumentSnapshotProvider must be mounted at workspace level above preview consumers and observe revision changes on Main dispatcher.
acceptance: Editor top bar displays [Files] sidebar toggle; opening it reveals the file tree on the left.
Selecting a file in the sidebar opens it directly into an editor tab without unmounting the editor.
Back press and Escape close the compact sidebar without leaving the project workspace.
Background editor input is completely suppressed while compact sidebar is open, even on read-only documents.
Markdown and HTML previews receive live document snapshots on revision change without creating a second text authority.
Actual CodeEditor view instance identity is preserved across 600 dp breakpoint width transitions.
